name: classic_rock
description: Classic rock (60s-80s analogue aesthetic). More midrange, less sub, less air than modern rock. Greater dynamic range from less aggressive limiting. Vintage tonal character.
sources: iZotope Tonal Balance Control 3 reference curve naming (Classic Rock)
Streaming mastering guides 2025: dynamic rock target -12 to -14 LUFS
Calibrated: modern_rock baseline + classic-rock spectral shifts (midrange +1.5, sub -2, air -1.5)
calibration_note: Tonal balance targets are wideband band-RMS at integrated_target LUFS. Derived from modern_rock baseline with documented classic-rock spectral biases.
